sections.label: Teen suicide causes in Singapore
sections.summary: Passage states common reasons for teen suicides in Singapore are interpersonal relationship and family issues and social stressors, requiring a whole-of-Government approach.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: The common reasons for teen suicides in Singapore are interpersonal relationship and family issues, as well as social stressors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: As the causes of suicides are often complex and multifaceted, we do want to take a whole-of-Government approach in dealing with suicides in the young.

sections.label: Counselling training and one hotline
sections.summary: Passage states counselling requires training, skills, emotional maturity and understanding, teenagers should not be expected to take crisis calls, and there should be one hotline.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: Counselling such persons requires relevant training, skills, emotional maturity and understanding of life's challenges.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: I think it would not be reasonable to expect teenagers to possess all these prerequisites to take crisis calls.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: For better awareness and dedication of resources, there should be just one hotline for such calls.

sections.label: Tracking suicide rates and age groups
sections.summary: Passage states suicides are tracked overall and by age group, youths aged 10 to 19 are relatively low, and international data is not available.

sentences.speaker: Mr Azmoon Ahmad (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Can I know, compared to the international standards, are we really that low or are we very far from international standards?

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: We track the number of suicides on an overall basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: We look at suicide rates of the different age groups.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: In terms of composition, the number of youths, basically those in the 10 to 19 age group, is relatively low.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: I do not have the data for the international numbers.
